question: how do i add my parent as an authorized user so they can pay my bill
answer:
Student Accounts: Log into [RCNJ Experience](https://experience.elluciancloud.com/rconj/), locate the Student Account Info card, click “Bill & Payment Suite,” then “Authorized Users” on the right side of the page in the My Profile Setup section. Click “Add Authorized User,” enter your parent’s email address, answer the questions, and click “Continue.” Click the “I Agree” box, then “Continue.” [4]

If you want them to make payments without seeing your bill or payment history, select “No” for both “View billing statement” and “View payment history” when adding them. [3] Authorized Users can make payments, receive e-bill notifications, and join the Ramapo Monthly Payment Plan. They cannot access stored payment methods or your academic or other personal information. Adding one does not permit Student Accounts to discuss your financial records with them; for that, complete and submit the Office of Student Accounts FERPA Waiver Form. [1]

**Student Accounts**: Phone: (201) 684-7495. Email: studentaccts@ramapo.edu. Location: D-Wing, First Floor. [21]

Sources: [1](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/users/) [3](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/billpolicies/) [4](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/users/) [21](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

question: I got a credit balance on my student account after my aid posted, how do I get that money sent to me? Do I need to sign up for direct deposit or does it just get mailed?
answer:
Student Accounts says that, unless you specify otherwise, the College issues a paper check mailed to your billing/permanent address; checks are not mailed to campus mailboxes and cannot be picked up at the Office. Title IV aid overpayments with a credit balance of $1.00 or greater are refunded; non-Title IV aid has a $5.00 threshold. [1]

You can instead use free electronic/direct deposit to a checking or savings account. To sign up, follow these steps: [1]
1. “Log into RCNJ Experience” [3]
2. “Locate the Student Account Info card” [3]
3. “Click on Bill & Payment Suite” [3]
4. “Click on Electronic Refunds on the right hand side of the screen under the My Profile Setup menu” [3]
5. “You must enroll in a Two-Step Verification Process (If previously completed, skip this step)” [3]
6. “Click on the Security Settings tab in My Profile” [3]
7. “Select a method to receive a passcode (text message, email or Google Authentication)” [3]
8. “Click the Send Code button” [3]
9. “Enter the passcode and click the Verify button” [3]
10. “Click on the Payment Profile tab in My Profile” [3]
11. “Edit existing saved Payment Method or Create New Payment Method” [3]
12. In the payment method, “click on check box in the Refund Option section to designate this payment method as the refund account for direct deposit.” [3]

After signing up, the page says to expect the refund within one to two weeks of submitting the application, if eligible. [2] For questions, contact Student Accounts.

**Student Accounts**: Phone: (201) 684-7495. Email: studentaccts@ramapo.edu. Location: D-Wing, First Floor. [21]

Sources: [1](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/deposits/) [2](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/direct-deposit-questions-answers/) [3](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/direct-deposit/) [21](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)
